lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: We-who knows, you don't even know what it'll cost, depends on where you move it.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: Quite a bit. (pause) An extra $16,000 for another basement. (pause) So what did you all help him with? Can I ask? Will you tell me? Brendan? Did you do it willingly? Huh? (Brendan shakes head "no") (pause) He did tell me one time, Steven, he told me that probably one or two of my kids would not graduate.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: Yeah. This was before this all even happened. So he must have had it all planned.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: You don't know how much hatred I got right now.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: You're right, I don't. I can only imagine. I-I can't even put myself in your shoes Barb, I can't.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: My oldest son is gonna flip. I can't even tell him. I can't.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: I can't, he's on a heart monitor now.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: This is gonna be on the media tonight.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: There's no way to stop it.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: He's not gonna be on, is he?
